Fresh synthetic setup, private teams, invitations, acceptance, enqueue and membership deletion use the application API
Only issue rank-exhaustion inputs and team counter seeded by scoped transaction under existing table-owning role; no raw job, progress, membership or credential writes
Only the same owned continuous worker is stopped and restored; actual default worker --once performs staging and access-loss transition
Three fixture teams sort after Example Team; bootstrap baseline first-team identity verified before manifest return
Complete IDs/counts-only manifest written to temporary directory mode 0700 and exclusive file mode 0600, removed on child success/failure/timeout
Node receives an explicit environment whitelist and application authentication inputs; no parent database/operator/worker credentials, proxy, Node options, Docker/Compose controls or fixture service
Environment filtering minimizes credentials; it is not a new OS sandbox
Parent HTTP opener disables proxies and redirects; error output withholds HTTP bodies and captured container credentials
not_executed: real HTTP or database fixture preparation
acceptance: Source and pure boundary verification only. Real fixture preparation, default worker behavior and full browser-suite acceptance remain lead-owned CI gates. No issue, milestone or product completion claimed.
migration_rollback: No schema or production changes. Revert these runner/helper changes to restore prior runner behavior; disposable run cleanup removes only its validated project volumes.
